en.headline: Hong Kong’s first fully autonomous robot retail stores open Tuesday
en.dek: Mainland firm Galbot launches three Galbot Store outlets at Hung Hom waterfront, Wan Chai waterfront and Kai Tak Sports Park, with Financial Secretary Paul Chan completing the first transaction at Kai Tak.
body: Hong Kong’s first fully autonomous robot-operated retail stores will begin formal operations on Tuesday. Mainland embodied-intelligence company Galbot is opening three Galbot Store outlets at the Hung Hom waterfront, Wan Chai waterfront and the underground level of Kai Tak Sports Park.

Financial Secretary Paul Chan attended the launch ceremony on Monday and completed the first transaction at the Kai Tak branch. He said Hong Kong can play a unique role in the development of embodied artificial intelligence by providing an international application scenario, a research ecosystem and capital support, and can become a hub for next-generation robot research and manufacturing through links with the Greater Bay Area.

Galbot founder and chief technology officer Wang He said the Hong Kong stores mark the company’s first step outside the mainland and a move from research into real-world operations. The stores feature humanoid robots that can take orders, retrieve goods and complete payment without human staff in the background, though some operations still require human support. The company already runs about 200 outlets across 50 mainland cities and plans further Hong Kong locations.

Hong Kong Investment Corporation chief executive officer Clara Chan said the corporation has invested in Galbot for two years and expects successful cases to strengthen the local innovation and capital ecosystem.

zh.headline: 本港首批全自主機械人零售店周二起營運
zh.dek: 內地具身智能企業銀河通用於紅磡海濱、灣仔海濱及啟德體育園開設三間Galbot Store，財政司司長陳茂波在啟德店完成首宗交易。
body: 本港首批全自主機械人零售店將於周二正式營運。內地具身智能企業銀河通用在紅磡新海濱、灣仔海濱及啟德體育園地下開設三間Galbot Store。
財政司司長陳茂波周一出席啟動禮，並在啟德分店完成首宗交易。他表示香港在具身智能發展可擔當獨特角色，提供國際化應用場景、研發生態及資本支持，並可藉大灣區聯繫成為下一代機械人研發與製造樞紐。
銀河通用創始人兼首席技術官王鶴表示，香港店是公司首次在境外落地，標誌由技術研發走向真實營運。店內人形機械人可自主接單、取貨及完成支付，毋須後台人員操控，部分運作仍需人手協助。公司在內地約50個城市已有約200間店，並計劃在港增設更多據點。
香港投資管理有限公司行政總裁陳家齊表示，港投兩年前已投資銀河通用，期望成功個案為本地創科及資本生態帶來飛輪效應。
